PAITAN ESTATE, Meridian Plantations Sdn Bhd (United Malacca Berhad group, UMB). Staff RM363,663 (-6%); labour overhead RM260,778 vs RM436,825 (recruitment RM45,364 vs RM202,236); office and related RM353,863 (+1%; water/electricity RM195,567, transport +58%, CSR RM7,720 vs RM840); depreciation RM763,486.

UPKEEP AND CULTIVATION (PA 2/2026 section 6, 4 months, mature 1,871 ha, FFB 10,825 t): RM1,512,013 vs RM1,806,143 budget, RM808/ha vs RM1,011/ha, RM140/t vs RM123/t, 16% under in money.
